# Askreative

Askreative is an Indonesian perfume and aromatherapy studio: custom perfume and
aromatherapy services, laboratory tools and ingredients, workshops, events,
articles, and a product catalogue.

Askreative berbasis di Indonesia dan melayani pembuatan parfum serta aromaterapi
kustom, penyediaan alat dan bahan laboratorium, workshop, kegiatan, artikel, dan
katalog produk.

## Main pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, featured products, events, articles, gallery
- [Services](/pos): Custom perfume and aromatherapy ordering
- [Workshops](/workshops): Perfume and aromatherapy workshops
- [Lab Tools](/lab-tools): Laboratory equipment catalogue
- [Ingredients](/ingredients): Perfume and aromatherapy raw materials
- [Products](/products): Finished perfume and aromatherapy products
- [Events](/events): Workshops and community events
- [Articles](/articles): Articles on perfume and aromatherapy
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photo gallery
- [About](/about): About Askreative

## Notes

- The site is a JavaScript single-page application; content is served from a
  JSON API under `/api/`.
- Contact details are available on the home page footer and the About page.
